description: Anyanwu — the Eye of the Sun. Stablecoin payroll for borderless teams on QIE: fund a treasury, pay your whole team in one run, stream pay as work happens, and keep a public record of every payment.
name: anyanwu

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @anyanwu/shared build && pnpm --filter @anyanwu/ledger build && pnpm --filter @anyanwu/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @anyanwu/shared test && pnpm --filter @anyanwu/ledger test && pnpm --filter @anyanwu/web test && forge test --root contracts
